C++ signed -1%7 is -1, while least nonnegative residue is6.
Seven bases are integers, not seven primes. Published fixed ranges must be separated from randomized independent uniform bases.
a==0 comment falsely says not prime, even though skipping this base is intentional.
Unsigned128 is suitable for uint64 products; signed128 cannot represent all such products.
klogN modular operations are not448total basic operations or universal microseconds/millionfold speedup.
64bit upper endpoint is N<2^64, not N<=2^64.
